(() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.wtb-tbody tr.wtb-row'); return rows.length === 10; })()

(() => { const vals = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.wtb-tbody tr.wtb-row')).map(r => { const tds = r.querySelectorAll('td'); const last = tds[tds.length - 1]; const m = (last.textContent || '').match(/([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)/); return m ? flows.name: P02 §9 原组合指令→候选→接受

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.text: 给「设备耗电明细」表做三件事：第一，把展示用的字段名做别名映射，「时间」映射成展示名「时间点」，「昨日耗电量」映射成展示名「昨日耗电量（kWh）」，源字段不变；第二，加一个展示过滤，只展示昨日耗电量大于 400 kWh 的记录；第三，按昨日耗电量降序排序并且只展示前 5 项。这三项都只影响展示，不要改变源数据和全量合计。

steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('chat-scroll').innerText || ''; return t.includes('时间点') && t.includes('昨日耗电量（kWh）') && t.includes('400') && t.includes('5'); })()

(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="pending_edit_plan_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const heads = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.wtb-thead th')).map(e => e.textContent.trim()); return heads.includes('时间点') && heads.includes('昨日耗电量（kWh）') && !heads.includes('时间') && !heads.includes('昨日耗电量'); })()
(() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.wtb-tbody tr.wtb-row'); return rows.length === 5; })()

(() => { const vals = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.wtb-tbody tr.wtb-row')).map(r => { const tds = r.querySelectorAll('td'); const last = tds[tds.length - 1]; const m = (last.textContent || '').match(/([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)/); return m ? Number(m[1]) : NaN; }); return vals.length === 5 && vals.every(v => v > 400) && vals.every((v, i) => i === 0 || vals[i - 1] >= v); })()

(() => { const value = document.querySelector('.wtb-summary__value'); const basis = document.querySelector('.wtb-summary__basis'); return !!value && value.textContent.includes('5297.2') && !!basis && basis.textContent.includes('全量'); })()
